TASK.TEXT: The lighthouse keeper rang the bell twice.
A thick fog drifted across the harbor.
Fishermen tied their boats to the docks.
Beneath the pier, an octopus changed color
from rusty red to pale sandy brown.
It slipped into a jar and closed the lid.
